description: Hoist attention-derivation logic from the kanban widget into the shared Issue entity so Kanban and the future Dashboard Attention Hero share a single source of truth.

tasks.title: Add shared attention-derivation module under entities/issue with entity public-API re-export and regression tests
tasks.description: Create packages/web/src/entities/issue/model/attention.ts containing AttentionItem, deriveAttentionItems(issues, agentStatus), and isIntegrateFailure(issue) as a verbatim behavioural copy of the current widget-local implementation. Re-export all three from packages/web/src/entities/issue/index.ts so any UI surface can import them through the Issue entity public API. Add a vitest spec at packages/web/src/entities/issue/model/attention.test.ts that locks in the four-rule evaluation order, the dedup-by-id behaviour, and the blockedReason-fallback detail for the Blocked rule. After this task the new module is consumable from any entity importer and is regression-locked, without yet touching any widget.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/entities/issue/model/attention.ts exports AttentionItem (with fields issueNumber, issueId, label, optional detail), deriveAttentionItems(issues, agentStatus), and isIntegrateFailure(issue)
The four evaluation rules appear in this exact order in deriveAttentionItems: approval-pending → integrate-failure → interrupted → blocked; the first match wins per issue
deriveAttentionItems deduplicates by issue.id so the same id never appears twice in the output
AgentStatus parameter is preserved in the signature (unused prefix underscore retained) so future rules can read it without changing the call site
packages/web/src/entities/issue/index.ts re-exports AttentionItem (type), deriveAttentionItems, and isIntegrateFailure from the new module

packages/web/src/entities/issue/model/attention.test.ts exists and contains vitest cases covering: approval-pending surfaces as 'Approval needed', integrate-stage Blocked/Interrupted surfaces as 'Integration failed', non-integrate Interrupted surfaces as 'Interrupted', Blocked uses blockedReason when present and falls back to title when absent, first-match wins for an issue that satisfies multiple rules, duplicate ids produce a single output item, all-healthy input produces an empty array
Running vitest on the new test file passes with zero failures
No file outside packages/web/src/entities/issue is modified in this task (the kanban widget still imports from its old local path and is unchanged)
tasks.output: Shared attention-derivation module is live and tested under the Issue entity public API; ready for any UI consumer (current kanban widget, future Dashboard) to import.
tasks.notes: Copy the function bodies verbatim from packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/model/homepage-attention.ts:21 to preserve bit-for-bit behaviour. Place the test file next to the module following the labels.test.ts / timeline-events.test.ts convention. Do not touch packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/* in this task — that is T-002.

tasks.title: Switch KanbanBoard to import attention derivation from the shared Issue entity and remove the widget-local copy
tasks.description: Update packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx to import deriveAttentionItems (and AttentionItem if referenced) from '../../../entities/issue' instead of '../model/homepage-attention'. Delete packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/model/homepage-attention.ts. Confirm the kanban widget's existing render path produces the same AttentionItem list as before by re-running its tests (no assertion edits). After this task the widget-local derivation is gone and the homepage 'Needs attention' summary on the Issues page reads from the shared Issue entity — Kanban and any future Dashboard consumer are now guaranteed to agree because there is only one derivation.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx imports deriveAttentionItems from '../../../entities/issue' and contains no import from '../model/homepage-attention'
packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/model/homepage-attention.ts no longer exists in the worktree
Running the existing kanban-board widget test suite passes with zero failures and zero assertion edits (assertions describe identical expected outputs)
grep -r "homepage-attention" packages/web/src returns no matches outside of any historical/archive paths

The Issues page 'Needs attention' summary visible output (labels, ordering, details) is unchanged for the same input — verified by passing existing kanban widget tests and by manual visual smoke if a fixture is available
Server-side MohistDefaultWorkflowProjection.RuntimeStatus is untouched — no files under packages/server/ are modified
